import java.util.*;

public class Buyhatke {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
		int t = s.nextInt();
		while (t-- > 0) {
			int n = s.nextInt();
			int[] arr = new int[n];
			int max = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				arr[i] = s.nextInt();
				max = Math.max(max, arr[i]);
			}
			Arrays.sort(arr);
			System.out.println(maxCountSameSUM(arr, n, max));

		}

	}

	public static int maxCountSameSUM(int arr[], int n, int maxi) {
		int max=0;
		for (int sum = 2; sum <= 100; sum++) {
			boolean[] visited = new boolean[n + 1];
			int c = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
				for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
					if (visited[j]) {
						continue;
					}
					if(visited[i]) {
						break;
					}
					if (arr[i] + arr[j] == sum) {
						visited[i] = true;
						visited[j] = true;
						c++;
						max = Math.max(max, c);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return max;
	}

}
